change.route: POST /api/v1/ingestion/cases/{caseId}/sources/{sourceId}/table answers 202 with a table-profile/1 job for a kept CSV above 16 MiB, or 201 with the table profile for a kept original of 16 MiB or less (CSV or XLSX)
change.admission: one transaction: replay by table-original:<requestKey> (same digest), workspace revision pin, kept-original refusals (profile, operator, already a table, superseded), then queue; no read in the request for a large CSV
change.job: operation table-profile through the one job authority (jobs row, registerUspJobInputTx with the intake scope, fenced claim, lease renewed every 30 s while the stream is read, acceptUspJobAttempt); job id stableUuid(table-profile/1:<sourceId>:<revision>:<requestKey>); a second read of the same original while one is queued or running is refused with 409
change.accept: attachTableTx, shared by the whole read and the job: same source row pins (latest revision of its family, sha256, revision, object key, no table receipt yet, else 409 with words), same manualProfile receipt, case revision +1, source.retained event. The whole read (16 MiB or less) also keeps the workspace revision its request pinned; the job does not, so other files kept in the workspace while it reads do not stop it
change.status: queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, stale; a stop keeps the reader's code and words; a 409 at accept (a new revision of the same source, the original changed, or another table receipt on it) marks the job stale
change.status_read: no generic USP job read route exists; the same request sent again answers the job as it stands, so no route was added
change.small_originals: up to 16 MiB a kept CSV or XLSX is read whole from its object, checked against its byte receipt and profiled with inspectTabularSource and the request's selection, in the request; no job
change.large_workbook: an XLSX above 16 MiB is refused before any read: 413 TABLE_ORIGINAL_WORKBOOK_SIZE, 'This workbook is more than 16 MiB; a workbook is read up to 16 MiB for now.'
change.add_files_path: POST .../sources (a CSV under 16 MiB from Add files) is not changed
change.studio: Import as a table for a CSV above 16 MiB keeps the upload words, then shows the job words (queued, running) and resends the same request every 2 s; it opens the table page on success, shows the reader's words on a stop and takes a new request key for the next try

tests.file: packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/table-windows.test.ts (fake pool emulating the job authority SQL)
tests.large_csv_test_only: generated in memory, 200,000 records: the request queues one job and reads nothing; the answer matches the 202 contract; a replay queues none; another request key while it is queued is refused; the job attaches 200,000 records; case revision 1; a replay then answers succeeded
tests.malformed_csv_test_only: the same generated CSV with an unclosed quote at the end: the job rejects with TABULAR_CSV_MALFORMED; a replay answers failed with that code and the reader's words; the source has no table receipt; case revision 0
tests.real_csv: fixtures mi-d10-02.csv kept through the batch becomes a table in the request: no job, case revision 1, replay equal, 201 contract
tests.real_xlsx: mi-d19-01.xlsx (sheet T_18, header rows 4-5) kept through the batch becomes a table in the request; needs ULPIN_PROFILE_PYTHON pointing at a Python with the reader's packages, skipped without it
tests.large_xlsx_test_only: a 16 MiB + 1 byte buffer kept as an .xlsx original is refused with the workbook words; no job
tests.g13_flow: G13's 200,000-row flow now queues, runs the job and goes on to windows and mapping unchanged; its events add job.succeeded
tests.other_source_during_job: the workspace revision moves while the job reads the object (another file kept): the job is accepted, 200,000 records, case revision 2, replay answers succeeded
tests.same_source_new_revision: the source's family gets revision 2 while the job reads: the job rejects with STALE_REVISION; replay answers stale, STALE_REVISION, 'This source revision has been superseded.'; no table receipt; case revision 1

not_measured: No live Postgres, object store or dispatcher was run in this task; the job SQL is checked against the fake pool and the backend typecheck. Time to read a multi-GiB CSV in the job is for the runtime owner to measure.
later: XW1 replaces the 413 refusal for an XLSX above 16 MiB with its windowed reader; the refusal is left as it is here
